Changelog

Oct 1, 2026

New mini program terms and clearer visual examples

  • Added Mini Program, WXML, WXSS, rpx, Page Lifecycle, and Subpackage Loading, with bilingual visual examples, practice questions, and AI prompts.
  • Follow one booking example to see where mini programs run, what templates and styles control, and how page width, navigation, and code packages affect the result.
  • Revised recent AI, backend, web, and product planning examples. Compare retrieved evidence, authorization, stored records, and page changes step by step to see what changed and what still needs checking.

Sep 20, 2026

Added 32 core terms with diagrams and practice questions

  • Added 32 core technical terms across AI foundations, backend data, web essentials, and product planning with Git. Each term includes interactive diagrams, practice questions, and practical AI prompts.
  • Explore how RAG answers from retrieved evidence, how hidden instructions in comments can interfere with an answer, and how object storage and databases divide their responsibilities.
  • Walk through multi-screen flows interactively with clickable prototypes. For Git conflicts, review both sides, remove markers, and commit cleanly; learn when to reset local commits versus reverting shared ones.
  • Use error messages and call records to locate app code, distinguish missing valid credentials from insufficient permission, and specify the scope of an AI task.

Refactored website course and streamlined chapter previews

  • Refactored the Product Website course into 9 focused chapters covering page structure, design tokens, hero CTA, layouts, pricing, spacing, forms, mobile responsive, and launch acceptance checklist.
  • Streamlined chapter titles and introductions across all courses, removing rhetorical filler to make learning objectives clear at a glance.
  • Simplified AI collaboration prompts across courses, helping beginners describe modular changes in everyday language and verify results easily.
Sep 9, 2026

New Hash and Pointer entries, plus light and dark modes

  • Added Hash and Pointer entries with diagrams, practice questions, and commands you can run yourself.
  • Follow how a content hash changes, why a page can still load an old file, and how to recover when shared settings are edited by mistake.
  • Switch between light and dark modes, with matching course illustrations and term examples.
  • The Git course now includes operation steps, result checks, and questions about staging, branches, merges, remote sync, and recovery.
  • After a correct answer, open the term in a new tab. The Configuration File entry clarifies runtime settings versus project rules.
  • The community menu lists VibeHub Group 6 and the GPT subscription services group separately.

terms.name: Mini Program
terms.tagline: 运行在微信等宿主应用里的轻量应用
terms.enTagline: A lightweight app that runs inside a host app such as WeChat

terms.name: WXML
terms.tagline: 用标签描述微信小程序页面结构，并绑定显示数据的语言
terms.enTagline: A markup language for describing a WeChat mini program’s page structure and binding displayed data

terms.name: WXSS
terms.tagline: 描述微信小程序组件外观和排版的样式语言
terms.enTagline: A style language that describes the appearance and layout of WeChat mini program components

terms.name: rpx
terms.tagline: 按小程序页面宽度换算显示大小的相对尺寸单位
terms.enTagline: A relative size unit converted according to a mini program page’s width

terms.name: Page Lifecycle
terms.tagline: 页面在创建、显示、隐藏和卸载等时机触发的一组回调
terms.enTagline: Callbacks triggered when a page is created, shown, hidden, or unloaded

terms.name: Subpackage Loading
terms.tagline: 把小程序代码拆成主包和按需加载的分包的机制
terms.enTagline: A mechanism that separates mini program code into a main package and subpackages loaded when needed

milestone.title: 新增 32 个核心术语，配有图解与练习
milestone.titleEn: Added 32 core terms with diagrams and practice questions

items.text: 新增 32 个核心技术术语，涵盖 AI 模型与运维、后端与数据、Web 基础以及产品规划与 Git 协作，配有交互图解、实操练习与向 AI Agent 表达的需求示例。

terms.name: HTTP Status Code
terms.tagline: 服务器用三位数字回答一次请求的结果：成功、重定向、请求有问题，还是服务器自己出错
terms.enTagline: A three-digit answer from the server about a request: success, redirect, a request problem, or a server failure

terms.name: Stack Trace
terms.tagline: 程序报错时列出的函数调用位置，通常从抛错帧开始，再列调用者
terms.enTagline: The position list printed when a program fails, ordered from the failure point back to the entry

terms.name: Timeout
terms.tagline: 一次操作等待结果的上限时间，超过后主动放弃并报告失败，而不是一直等下去
terms.enTagline: The maximum time to wait for a result before giving up and reporting failure

terms.name: Merge Conflict
terms.tagline: 两边改动无法自动合并时，Git 会暂停并标出需要人判断的内容
terms.enTagline: When the same content was changed differently on two branches, Git cannot choose and a person must decide what to keep

terms.name: Remote Repository
terms.tagline: 位于另一处、可通过网络访问并与本地仓库交换提交的仓库
terms.enTagline: A repository accessible elsewhere that exchanges commits with a local repository

terms.name: Reset & Revert
terms.tagline: reset 移动当前分支指针并按模式处理改动；revert 追加一条抵消旧改动的新提交
terms.enTagline: Reset moves the current branch and handles changes by mode; revert adds a commit that offsets an earlier change

terms.name: Node.js
terms.tagline: 让 JavaScript 能在浏览器以外运行的环境，常用于本地脚本和构建工具
terms.enTagline: A runtime for JavaScript outside the browser, often used by local scripts and build tools

terms.name: Dependency
terms.tagline: 项目声明会使用的外部代码包，通常由包管理器按清单安装
terms.enTagline: External code packages a project declares it will use, usually installed from its manifest by a package manager

terms.name: Semantic Versioning
terms.tagline: 用主版本、次版本和修订号表达公开 API 兼容承诺的版本规则
terms.enTagline: A versioning rule that uses major, minor, and patch to express a public API compatibility promise

terms.name: RAG
terms.tagline: 回答时先从指定资料中检索相关片段，再把它们交给模型参考的做法
terms.enTagline: A method that retrieves relevant passages from specified material at answer time and gives them to the model

terms.name: Prompt Injection
terms.tagline: 输入中的非预期指令让模型偏离原本任务或授权范围的安全问题
terms.enTagline: A security problem where instructions in input steer a model away from its intended task or authorization boundaries

terms.name: Temperature
terms.tagline: 在支持该设置的生成接口中，调节采样输出随机程度的参数
terms.enTagline: A parameter that adjusts sampling randomness in generation APIs and models that support it

terms.name: Fine-tuning
terms.tagline: 用任务示例继续训练已有模型，使它在特定任务上的输出更贴近示例
terms.enTagline: Continuing to train an existing model with task examples so its outputs better match them on a specific task

terms.name: Reasoning Model
terms.tagline: 为复杂问题使用额外内部推理计算的一类大模型
terms.enTagline: A class of language models that uses additional internal reasoning computation for harder problems

terms.name: Agent Memory
terms.tagline: Agent 保存并在后续交互中取回部分信息的机制，具体范围取决于产品和设置
terms.enTagline: A mechanism for an Agent to save and retrieve selected information in later interactions; its scope depends on the product and settings

terms.name: Scope Creep
terms.tagline: 项目执行时，未经评估的新要求不断混进已约定的工作范围
terms.enTagline: New requests continually enter agreed project work without being evaluated

terms.name: Technical Debt
terms.tagline: 当前可用的实现方式留下了会增加后续改动负担的结构问题
terms.enTagline: A usable implementation choice that leaves structural issues adding to later change work

terms.name: Persona
terms.tagline: 把目标用户的行为、目标和顾虑整理成可讨论的代表性模型
terms.enTagline: An evidence-based model of a target user's behavior, goals, and concerns

terms.name: Prototype
terms.tagline: 用可点击的界面模型走查页面顺序、分支和返回路径
terms.enTagline: A clickable interface model for walking through page order, branches, and recovery paths

terms.name: Event Tracking
terms.tagline: 在页面动作发生时记录事件，并把事件数据交给统计工具
terms.enTagline: A record of a page action sent to an analytics tool when the action occurs

terms.name: Object Storage
terms.tagline: 把图片、视频和附件作为完整文件对象保存的存储服务，按对象键或地址读取
terms.enTagline: A cloud storage service specialized in whole objects like images, videos, and files, accessed by link

terms.name: Primary Key
terms.tagline: 一张表里用来唯一区分每一行的字段
terms.enTagline: The field in a table used to uniquely identify each row

terms.name: Session
terms.tagline: 服务器为“同一个人连续操作”保持的一段状态，靠 Cookie 里的标识认人
terms.enTagline: State a service keeps for a signed-in person and can look up using a browser-held identifier

terms.name: OAuth
terms.tagline: 让用户授权客户端在限定范围内访问受保护资源的协议
terms.enTagline: A protocol for granting a client scoped access to protected resources

terms.name: Webhook
terms.tagline: 事情发生时，由对方主动向你指定的地址发一条通知的机制
terms.enTagline: A mechanism where the other party proactively notifies an address you configured when something happens

terms.name: HTTP Methods
terms.tagline: HTTP 请求中的方法，用来表达客户端想对目标资源做什么
terms.enTagline: The verb in a request stating which kind of operation it performs: read, create, update, or delete

terms.name: IP Address
terms.tagline: 网络层用于定位接口并转发数据的数字地址
terms.enTagline: A network-layer address used to locate an interface and route data

terms.name: WebSocket
terms.tagline: 握手后保持打开的双向连接，双方可以互相发送消息
terms.enTagline: A connection that stays open, letting both sides send messages at any time

terms.name: Regex
terms.tagline: 用一串符号描述要匹配的文字，可用于查找或限制输入格式
terms.enTagline: A notation for describing text to match, search, or constrain

terms.name: Keyframe
terms.tagline: 在动画时间线上标出样式状态点；浏览器对可插值的属性计算中间值
terms.enTagline: The state points you specify in an animation; the browser interpolates animatable properties between specified points

terms.name: Prefers Reduced Motion
terms.tagline: 读取用户的系统动效偏好，并减少或替换非必要的动态效果
terms.enTagline: Reading the system's reduce motion setting and disabling or reducing animation accordingly

terms.cn: 语义化标签与标题层级
terms.name: Semantic HTML
terms.tagline: 用有含义的 HTML 标签标明这段内容在文档里的角色，例如标题、列表、导航
terms.enTagline: HTML tags that mark each section's role in the document, such as headings, lists, and navigation

terms.name: Contract Testing

terms.name: Heuristic Evaluation

terms.name: Message Queue

terms.name: Transaction
terms.tagline: 作为一个整体提交或回滚的一组数据库操作。
terms.enTagline: A group of related database operations that are committed or rolled back as a whole

terms.name: Atomicity
terms.tagline: 一组相关操作要么整体生效，要么整体不生效，中间结果不能被当成最终结果。
terms.enTagline: The property that related operations either all take effect or none of them does

terms.name: Database Write
terms.tagline: 把新增或修改的数据写入数据库并完成提交。
terms.enTagline: Writing new or updated data to a database and committing the change

terms.name: Process
terms.tagline: 操作系统中正在运行的程序实例，拥有独立的内存空间、系统资源和进程编号（PID）。
terms.enTagline: A process is a running program together with the separate resource environment assigned by the operating system.

terms.name: Thread
terms.tagline: 进程内部由操作系统调度的最小执行单元；同一进程内的多个线程通常共享内存与系统资源。
terms.enTagline: A thread is an execution path inside a process, and threads in one process usually share memory and resources.

terms.name: Coroutine
terms.tagline: 在明确暂停点主动挂起并让出执行权、待条件满足后再恢复执行的轻量级并发单元。
terms.enTagline: A coroutine is a lightweight execution unit that can suspend at explicit points and resume later.

terms.name: Enqueue
terms.tagline: 将待处理任务写入队列暂存，使当前请求能先获得任务凭证并快速返回，再由后台异步执行的操作。
terms.enTagline: Enqueue puts work into a queue so a request can receive a task ID before a later processor runs it

terms.name: Idempotency
terms.tagline: 同一个请求重复到达时，预期的业务效果仍只发生一次。
terms.enTagline: A repeated request produces the same intended business effect instead of applying it again

terms.name: Side Effect
terms.tagline: 函数或请求在计算返回自身结果之外，对外部系统状态造成的变更或触发的额外操作。
terms.enTagline: A function or request changes external state or triggers an external action beyond returning a value

terms.name: Lock
terms.tagline: 限制多个并发操作同时访问同一共享资源，确保同一时间只有一个执行者能够修改状态的同步机制。
terms.enTagline: A lock is a concurrency-control mechanism that limits simultaneous access to a shared resource.

terms.name: Race Condition
terms.tagline: 多个并发操作因执行时序或交错顺序不确定，导致系统出现偶发错误或状态不一致的并发缺陷。
terms.enTagline: A race condition occurs when the ordering of concurrent operations changes the final result.

terms.name: Audit Log
terms.tagline: 按时间顺序记录谁在何时对什么对象执行了什么操作，以及最终成功或被拒绝的结果。
terms.enTagline: An audit log records who did what to which object, when, and with what result.

terms.name: Load Testing
terms.tagline: 在模拟真实业务规模的并发请求下，测量系统延迟、吞吐量和错误率等表现的性能测试方法。
terms.enTagline: Load testing measures latency, throughput, and errors while a system handles a realistic level of load.

terms.name: Message Consumer
terms.tagline: 从消息队列中获取待处理消息并执行业务逻辑，处理完成后向队列反馈确认状态的服务实例或后台进程。
terms.enTagline: A message consumer is an application or instance that receives messages from a queue, handles them according to its rules, and acknowledges their processing status

terms.name: Circuit Breaker
terms.tagline: 当外部依赖连续失败时主动切断调用并快速返回降级结果，避免自身被拖垮，并在稍后自动探测恢复的保护机制。
terms.enTagline: A circuit breaker cuts off a repeatedly failing dependency, fails fast or degrades, and probes recovery later

terms.name: Backpressure
terms.tagline: 下游处理能力不足时，将减速或暂停信号反向传递给上游以限制任务流入的反馈机制。
terms.enTagline: Backpressure sends a downstream slowdown or pause signal upstream to limit new or unfinished work

terms.name: Lease
terms.tagline: 带有明确有效期的临时持有权；持有者需定期续约，超时失效后其他节点方可安全接管。
terms.enTagline: A lease is time-limited ownership that must be renewed and can be taken over after it expires

terms.name: Distributed System
terms.tagline: 由多个计算节点组成，并通过网络协作完成共同任务的系统。
terms.enTagline: A distributed system uses multiple computing nodes that coordinate over a network to achieve a system goal.

terms.name: Single-Instance Deployment
terms.tagline: 在运行环境中仅为某个服务保留单个运行副本，所有流量由该唯一实例处理的部署形态。
terms.enTagline: Single-instance deployment keeps exactly one running replica of a service in its environment.

terms.name: Multi-Instance Deployment
terms.tagline: 让同一个后端服务同时运行多个对等的运行副本，并通过负载均衡共同承载流量与提供容灾冗余的部署形态。
terms.enTagline: Multi-instance deployment runs multiple instances of the same service that receive requests together.

terms.name: Provider
terms.tagline: Provider 是你通过它访问 AI 模型的服务平台与基础设施实体。
terms.enTagline: A platform or infrastructure entity that hosts, runs, and serves large language models through APIs.

terms.name: Base URL
terms.tagline: Base URL（基准地址）是一组 API 请求共同使用的地址前缀。
terms.enTagline: An address prefix shared by a group of API requests, onto which specific endpoint paths are appended.

terms.name: API Proxy
terms.tagline: API 代理是位于客户端和上游 API 之间，代为接收和转发请求与响应的中间服务。
terms.enTagline: An intermediate service that receives and forwards requests and responses between a client and an upstream API.

terms.name: OpenAI-Compatible API
terms.tagline: 与 OpenAI 接口的请求和响应格式相近，允许兼容客户端平滑切换底层模型服务的一类兼容接口。
terms.enTagline: A third-party model endpoint conforming to OpenAI request and response formats, allowing compatible clients to switch providers seamlessly.

terms.name: Configuration File
terms.tagline: 配置文件是用文件保存的软件设置，供程序在启动或运行时读取。
terms.enTagline: A structured file containing runtime settings and environment parameters for software to parse upon startup or runtime.

terms.name: Profile
terms.tagline: 命名保存的一组配置集合，用于在工作、个人或不同模型服务环境之间一键整体切换。
terms.enTagline: A named and saved collection of configuration settings for switching between work, personal, or different provider environments.

terms.name: Project Rules
terms.tagline: 保存在工程目录中的规范文件，用于向 AI 智能体注入团队技术栈、代码约定与操作边界约束。
terms.enTagline: Repository-level instruction files that inject team stack requirements, coding conventions, and operational boundaries into an AI agent.

terms.name: Hook
terms.tagline: 在特定生命周期事件触发时，自动截获流程并执行预设脚本或检查的任务机制。
terms.enTagline: An automated mechanism that intercepts execution upon specific lifecycle events to run predefined scripts or checks.

terms.name: Plugin
terms.tagline: 独立封装并安装到宿主应用中，按标准扩展点为其补充功能、命令或界面的可分发模块。
terms.enTagline: A distributable software package installed into a host application to provide extended capabilities, commands, or UI via standardized extension points.

terms.name: Permission Mode
terms.tagline: 规范 AI 智能体执行任务时，预设的一组访问范围和审批设置。
terms.enTagline: A set of control presets defining file system boundaries, network access limits, and user confirmation triggers for an AI agent.

terms.name: Sandbox
terms.tagline: 限制不受信代码或自动化任务对宿主文件、网络与系统调用的物理或逻辑隔离运行环境。
terms.enTagline: An isolated execution environment restricting the files, network, and system resources accessible by untrusted code or automated tasks.

terms.name: Sort
terms.tagline: 排序是把列表按某个字段排先后——按日期从新到旧、按金额从大到小，记录一条不少，只是换了位置。
terms.enTagline: Sorting puts a list in order by one field—newest first, or largest amount first—without removing a single record.

terms.name: Import & Export
terms.tagline: 导入导出是把数据整批搬进或搬出：导出存成 CSV、Excel 这样的文件，导入把文件变回一条条记录。
terms.enTagline: Import and export move data in bulk: export saves records into files like CSV or Excel, import turns a file back into records.

terms.name: Placeholder
terms.tagline: 占位文字是输入框里的灰色示例，告诉你该填什么格式；一开始输入就消失。
terms.enTagline: A placeholder is the gray example inside an input box showing the expected format; it vanishes the moment you type.

terms.name: Undo
terms.tagline: 撤销是把刚做的一步操作原样退回去——删错的东西按 Ctrl+Z 就回来，不用重做。
terms.enTagline: Undo rolls your last action back exactly as it was—Ctrl+Z brings the wrongly deleted row back, no retyping.

terms.name: Prompt
terms.tagline: 输入给大语言模型以引导其生成特定格式与内容结果的指令与上下文文本。
terms.enTagline: A prompt is the message you send the AI—the problem, requirements, and context all live in it, and it steers what the AI builds.

terms.name: Wireframe
terms.tagline: 线框图是用灰块和占位线画出的页面骨架——只定「哪里放什么」，不谈颜色和字体。
terms.enTagline: A wireframe is the page skeleton drawn in gray blocks and placeholder lines—it fixes "what goes where" before any colors or fonts.

terms.name: Contrast
terms.tagline: 对比度是指文字与背景之间的明暗反差，直接决定内容是否清晰可辨。
terms.enTagline: Contrast is the brightness difference between text and background—big enough to read; light gray on light gray is not.

terms.name: Visual Hierarchy
terms.tagline: 视觉层级是让访客按你想要的顺序看页面——先看主标题，再看说明，最后注意到按钮。
terms.enTagline: Visual hierarchy makes visitors read the page in your intended order—headline first, description next, button last.

terms.name: Moodboard
terms.tagline: 情绪板是开工前把参考图、配色和关键词拼在一张板上——先对齐「想要什么感觉」，再动手做页面。
terms.enTagline: A moodboard collects reference images, colors, and keywords on one board—align on "what feeling" before building the page.

terms.name: Accessibility
terms.tagline: 无障碍是让更多人在更多场景下都能用你的页面——不光靠鼠标、不光靠好视力、屏幕读出来也能懂。
terms.enTagline: Accessibility means more people can use your page in more situations—not only with a mouse, not only with perfect vision, and even read aloud by a screen reader.

terms.name: API Key
terms.tagline: 供应用程序向接口服务表明身份、验证调用权限并追踪资源用量的访问凭证。
terms.enTagline: An authentication credential used by applications to prove identity, verify permissions, and track resource usage with an API service.

terms.name: CRUD
terms.tagline: 增删改查是对同一类数据反复做的四种基本操作：创建、读取、更新和删除。
terms.enTagline: CRUD is the four basic operations repeatedly performed on one kind of data: create, read, update, and delete.

terms.name: Field
terms.tagline: 字段是一条记录里单独的一项信息，比如客户名、金额或日期。
terms.enTagline: A field is one standalone piece of information in a record, such as client name, amount, or date.

terms.name: Data Type
terms.tagline: 数据类型是一条信息的格式约定：文字、数字、日期还是开关值。
terms.enTagline: A data type is the format agreement for one piece of information: text, number, date, or an on/off value.

terms.name: Logo
terms.tagline: 用来识别组织、产品或服务的品牌标志
terms.enTagline: A brand mark used to identify an organization, product, or service

terms.name: Cookie
terms.tagline: 由浏览器按服务器要求保存并在符合规则的后续请求中自动携带的文本数据
terms.enTagline: A cookie is a small piece of data the browser stores by server rules and sends automatically on matching later requests.

terms.name: Cache
terms.tagline: 暂存可以复用的结果，让后续请求不必每次都回到源站
terms.enTagline: Keep reusable results so later requests do not always return to the origin

terms.name: Canonical URL
terms.tagline: 在多个相同或相近页面中声明更希望被当作代表版本的 URL
terms.enTagline: A preferred representative URL for pages with the same or very similar content

terms.name: XML Sitemap
terms.tagline: 用机器可读的 XML 文件列出希望爬虫发现的重要 URL
terms.enTagline: List important canonical URLs in a machine-readable XML file for crawler discovery

terms.name: Robots.txt
terms.tagline: 放在站点根目录、告诉自动爬虫哪些路径可以抓取的规则文件
terms.enTagline: A root-level file that tells automated crawlers which paths they may crawl

terms.name: Not Found Page
terms.tagline: 资源不存在时返回 404，并给用户一条可以继续走的路径
terms.enTagline: Return 404 for a missing resource and give people a way to recover

terms.name: CSS
terms.tagline: CSS 是用规则描述网页外观、布局和不同空间下变化方式的样式语言。
terms.enTagline: CSS is a style language that describes a web page's appearance, layout, and changes across available space.

terms.name: DOM
terms.tagline: DOM 是浏览器把网页文档表示成可读取和修改的节点树。
terms.enTagline: The DOM is the node tree the browser uses to represent and modify a web document.

terms.name: Title Tag
terms.tagline: HTML 文档用来标识当前页面的标题
terms.enTagline: The HTML title that identifies the current document

terms.name: Page Metadata
terms.tagline: 描述网页但不直接显示在正文中的页面信息
terms.enTagline: Information about a page that is read outside its visible body

terms.name: Favicon
terms.tagline: 浏览器用来识别网站的小图标
terms.enTagline: A small icon browsers use to identify a website

terms.name: Open Graph
terms.tagline: 用 og:* 元数据描述链接分享预览的内容
terms.enTagline: og:* metadata that describes a shared-link preview

terms.name: App Icon
terms.tagline: 操作系统用来识别应用的品牌图像
terms.enTagline: A brand image the operating system uses to identify an app

terms.name: Web App Manifest
terms.tagline: 描述 Web 应用名称、图标和启动方式的 JSON 文件
terms.enTagline: A JSON file that describes a Web app's name, icons, and launch behavior

terms.name: Browser DevTools
terms.tagline: 浏览器开发者工具是一组用来检查网页结构、样式、错误、请求和存储状态的内置工具。
terms.enTagline: Browser DevTools are built-in tools for inspecting page structure, styles, errors, requests, and storage state.

terms.name: Web Hosting
terms.tagline: 持续保存并向用户提供网站文件或运行环境的服务
terms.enTagline: A service that continuously stores and serves website files or a running environment

milestone.title: 设计风格与版式布局词条
milestone.summary: 扩充现代网页主流的版式布局与经典设计流派词条。
milestone.summaryEn: Expanded design styles with masonry, split-screen, Art Deco, and Brutalism.

items.text: 新增瀑布流布局、分屏布局、Art Deco 风格、野兽派风格等版式词条
items.textEn: Added masonry, split-screen, Art Deco, and Brutalist design terms

terms.name: Masonry
terms.tagline: 瀑布流是一种保持列对齐、让不同高度的卡片依次补进当前最短列的页面布局
terms.enTagline: Pack cards of different heights into equal-width columns

terms.name: Split-screen
terms.tagline: 分屏布局是一种把首屏分成两个权重接近的区域、各自承载一个并列任务或入口的页面结构
terms.enTagline: Give two parallel tasks two near-equal halves of one view

terms.name: Bauhaus
terms.tagline: 包豪斯是一种用基础几何形、材料特性和功能需求组织画面的现代主义设计流派
terms.enTagline: Organize the page with basic geometry, honest materials, and function

terms.name: Art Deco
terms.tagline: 装饰艺术是一种用几何对称、阶梯轮廓和放射纹样表现现代奢华的设计流派
terms.enTagline: Express modern luxury through symmetry, stepped contours, and radiating motifs

milestone.title: 发布与部署策略系列
milestone.summary: 上线蓝绿部署与金丝雀发布词条，优化全站目录筛选定位。
milestone.summaryEn: Added blue-green deployment and canary release terms, refined sticky filters.

items.text: 新增蓝绿部署与金丝雀发布策略词条，帮助理解现代发布风险控制
items.textEn: Added blue-green deployment and canary release terms for deployment risk control

items.text: 浏览较长的目录时，分类筛选栏会保留在顶部，方便切换。
items.textEn: Category filters stay at the top while browsing long lists.

terms.name: Canary Release
terms.tagline: 金丝雀发布是先把新版本交给少量真实流量验证，再根据健康信号扩大或停止的发布策略。
terms.enTagline: A canary release exposes a new version to a small amount of real traffic before health signals decide whether to expand or stop.

terms.name: Blue-Green Deployment
terms.tagline: 蓝绿部署是用两套都能承载生产的环境运行新旧版本，验证候选环境后再切换流量的部署策略。
terms.enTagline: Blue-green deployment runs old and new releases in two production-capable environments, then switches traffic after the candidate environment is verified.

milestone.summaryEn: Launched the Anti-AI Flavor guide to help identify and fix recurring AI slop.

items.textEn: Provided actionable agent prompts and before/after comparisons for each slop tell

milestone.summaryEn: Added local term favorites with offline persistence and smooth transitions.

items.textEn: Save terms without signing in and review your favorites by category

items.textEn: Released the baseline catalog of 244 foundational frontend, design, and git terms

items.textEn: Added 30 beginner-friendly interactive practice questions with immediate feedback

terms.name: Button
terms.tagline: 按钮是让用户在当前页面执行保存、提交、删除等操作的可点击控件
terms.enTagline: Click to save, submit, delete, or run another action

terms.name: Link
terms.tagline: 链接是带用户前往另一个页面、页内位置或资源地址的可点击文本或元素
terms.enTagline: Click to open another page, location, or file

terms.name: Typography
terms.tagline: 排版是指页面中文字的字号、字重、行距与层级规范，帮助读者快速识别标题、正文与辅助信息。
terms.enTagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first

terms.name: Divider
terms.tagline: 分割线是用细线分开相邻内容分组的视觉元素
terms.enTagline: Use a line to separate two different groups of content

terms.name: Space
terms.tagline: 间距是用内容之间的留白表达关联和分组关系的布局规则
terms.enTagline: Use empty space to show which things belong together

terms.name: Input
terms.tagline: 输入框是让用户填写账号、搜索词等短文本的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Let the user enter one line of text

terms.name: Textarea
terms.tagline: 多行文本框是让用户输入或编辑多段自由文本的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Let the user enter several lines of text

terms.name: Number Input
terms.tagline: 数字输入框是用于填写数值并按设定步长增减的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Enter a number with a defined range and step

terms.name: Radio
terms.tagline: 单选框是一组只能选中其中一个选项的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Choose exactly one option from a small set

terms.name: Checkbox
terms.tagline: 复选框是让用户独立选中一个或多个选项的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Choose one, several, or none of the options

terms.name: Switch
terms.tagline: 在开启与关闭两种对立状态之间即时切换的开关控件。
terms.enTagline: Turn a setting on or off immediately

terms.name: Slider
terms.tagline: 滑块是沿着一段连续或分级范围调整数值的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Drag to adjust a value within a range

terms.name: Rate
terms.tagline: 评分控件是让用户在有顺序的等级中选择评价分值的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Express a rating with stars or ordered levels

terms.name: Select
terms.tagline: 选择器是从固定选项列表中选择一个或多个值的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Choose one value from a collapsed list

terms.name: Autocomplete
terms.tagline: 自动完成是在用户输入时显示匹配建议、帮助更快完成输入的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Show matching suggestions while the user types

terms.name: Cascader
terms.tagline: 点开一个选项后继续选择下一级，常见于省、市、区选择
terms.enTagline: Choose a path one level at a time

terms.name: Tree Select
terms.tagline: 在可展开的父子列表里勾选一个或多个项目
terms.enTagline: Choose one or more items from a hierarchy

terms.name: Date Picker
terms.tagline: 日期选择器是用日历选择某一天或一段日期的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Choose a date or date range from a calendar

terms.name: Time Picker
terms.tagline: 时间选择器是让用户从允许范围中选择具体时刻的表单控件
terms.enTagline: Choose a specific time within allowed hours

terms.name: Upload
terms.tagline: 让用户从电脑或手机选择图片、视频或文档，并提交给当前网站或软件
terms.enTagline: Send a file from a device to the website

terms.name: Form
terms.tagline: 网页或软件里让用户填写并提交一组信息的区域，比如注册、下单或修改资料
terms.enTagline: Collect several fields and submit them as one task

terms.name: Color Picker
terms.tagline: 颜色选择器是让用户查看并选择颜色值的表单控件
terms.enTagline: A form control for viewing and choosing a color value

terms.name: Label
terms.tagline: 表单标签是说明一个输入控件需要填写或选择什么的可见文字
terms.enTagline: Visible text that tells people what a form control asks for

terms.name: Table
terms.tagline: 表格是按行和列展示同一组字段、便于比较多条记录的数据组件
terms.enTagline: Compare many records across the same columns

terms.name: List
terms.tagline: 列表是按相同结构连续排列多条内容或记录的数据组件
terms.enTagline: Show similar items one after another

terms.name: Card
terms.tagline: 卡片是把同一对象的标题、摘要、图片和操作组织在一起的内容容器
terms.enTagline: Keep information about one item in a single block

terms.name: Tag
terms.tagline: 标签是用短文字标记内容状态、类别、属性或筛选条件的组件
terms.enTagline: Mark a status, category, or selected condition with short text

terms.name: Badge
terms.tagline: 徽标是附着在其他元素旁、补充数量或状态的简短标记
terms.enTagline: Add a count or compact status next to another object

terms.name: Avatar
terms.tagline: 头像是用于识别用户、团队或组织的图像、首字或标志组件
terms.enTagline: Represent a person, team, or organization visually

terms.name: Descriptions
terms.tagline: 在详情页里用“字段名 + 内容”展示一条记录的只读信息
terms.enTagline: Show the field names and values of one record

terms.name: Statistic
terms.tagline: 在首页或数据看板上突出显示人数、金额、比例等关键数字
terms.enTagline: Highlight a small number of important values

terms.name: Tabs
terms.tagline: 标签页是在同一页面内切换平级内容面板的导航组件
terms.enTagline: Switch between a few peer sections on the same page

terms.name: Segmented
terms.tagline: 把少量选项并排放在一起，点一下就切换当前查看方式
terms.enTagline: Switch quickly between a few short, exclusive modes

terms.name: Collapse
terms.tagline: 折叠面板是可按需展开或收起一组内容的界面组件
terms.enTagline: Hide secondary details until the user asks for them

terms.name: Timeline
terms.tagline: 时间轴是按时间顺序展示一组事件、状态或记录的数据组件
terms.enTagline: Show a sequence of events in time order

terms.name: Tree
terms.tagline: 把文件夹、部门或分类按父子关系排列，并让用户逐层展开或收起
terms.enTagline: Expand and browse data with parent-child levels

terms.name: Carousel
terms.tagline: 走马灯是在同一内容区域轮流展示多张幻灯片的轮播组件
terms.enTagline: Show several panels one at a time in the same space

terms.name: Empty
terms.tagline: 空状态是在内容区域没有可展示数据时说明原因和下一步的界面状态
terms.enTagline: Explain why no data is shown and what to do next

terms.name: Image
terms.tagline: 在网页或软件里显示头像、商品图、文章配图等图片
terms.enTagline: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback

terms.name: File
terms.tagline: 文件项是展示单个文档、图片或附件名称、状态和操作的界面单元
terms.enTagline: A UI row or card that shows one document, image, or attachment and its status

terms.name: Icon
terms.tagline: 图标是用统一的小型视觉符号表示功能、对象或状态的界面元素
terms.enTagline: A small, consistent visual symbol for an action, object, or status

terms.name: Quote
terms.tagline: 引用是从正文中区分出来、并标明来源的原话或文字摘录
terms.enTagline: A sourced quotation or excerpt set apart from the surrounding text

terms.name: Video
terms.tagline: 视频是可在页面中播放、包含连续画面和时间进度的媒体内容
terms.enTagline: Media with moving images and a duration that plays on a page

terms.name: Alert
terms.tagline: 警告提示是嵌在页面内容中、持续说明状态、风险或异常的提示组件
terms.enTagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

terms.name: Toast
terms.tagline: 轻提示是在页面上短暂显示、反馈刚完成操作的提示组件
terms.enTagline: Briefly confirm a small action that just finished

terms.name: Notification
terms.tagline: 在页面角落或通知中心出现，提醒用户某件事已经发生或需要处理
terms.enTagline: Notify the user about an event with a title and details

terms.name: Modal
terms.tagline: 在当前页面上方居中弹出的阻断式对话框，用于聚焦单一核心操作。
terms.enTagline: Pause the page for one focused decision or task

terms.name: Drawer
terms.tagline: 从屏幕边缘滑出的覆盖层面板，用于展示承载较多内容的辅助操作。
terms.enTagline: Slide in a side panel without leaving the current page

terms.name: Popconfirm
terms.tagline: 触发危险或关键操作时在控件就近浮现的目标二次确认浮层。
terms.enTagline: Ask for confirmation next to the action that caused it

terms.name: Popover
terms.tagline: 气泡卡片是贴近触发元素展开、可承载补充信息和少量操作的浮层组件
terms.enTagline: Open a small panel with extra information or controls

terms.name: Tooltip
terms.tagline: 鼠标悬停或聚焦时浮现的轻量级文字提示气泡。
terms.enTagline: Explain a compact control with a short text label

terms.name: Progress
terms.tagline: 进度条是用长度、百分比或阶段表示任务完成程度的状态组件
terms.enTagline: Show how much of a task has been completed

terms.name: Skeleton
terms.tagline: 页面加载时先出现的灰色轮廓，用来占住稍后内容的位置
terms.enTagline: Reserve the layout while content is loading

terms.name: Result
terms.tagline: 结果页是在一个完整流程结束后集中说明结果和下一步操作的页面状态
terms.enTagline: Explain the final outcome and the next available step

terms.name: Spinner
terms.tagline: 旋转加载指示器是用持续旋转表示系统正在处理、但完成度未知的状态组件
terms.enTagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

terms.name: Menu
terms.tagline: 导航菜单是按层级组织页面或功能入口、帮助用户在产品中移动的导航组件
terms.enTagline: Help people move between the main sections of a product

terms.name: Breadcrumb
terms.tagline: 面包屑是按层级展示当前页面路径、帮助用户返回上级的导航组件
terms.enTagline: Show the path from a broad section to the current page

terms.name: Pagination
terms.tagline: 分页是把大量结果分成多个可定位页面浏览的导航组件
terms.enTagline: Move through a large result set in separate pages

terms.name: Steps
terms.tagline: 步骤条是展示多步流程及当前进度的导航与状态组件
terms.enTagline: Show progress through a task with several required stages

terms.name: Dropdown
terms.tagline: 下拉菜单是点击一个入口后展开一组相关操作的浮层菜单组件
terms.enTagline: Open a compact menu of actions or destinations

terms.name: Anchor
terms.tagline: 锚点是让用户在同一长页面内跳到指定章节位置的页内导航链接
terms.enTagline: Jump to a named section on the same long page

terms.name: Back to Top Button
terms.tagline: 回到顶部是让用户从长页面当前位置快速返回页首的导航按钮
terms.enTagline: Return quickly to the top of a long page

terms.name: Skip Link
terms.tagline: 键盘用户按 Tab 后出现的快捷入口，点击可直接跳过顶部导航到正文
terms.enTagline: A link that lets keyboard users skip repeated navigation and move to the main content

terms.name: Margin
terms.tagline: 元素边框外侧与其他相邻元素之间的外侧间隔距离。
terms.enTagline: Create space outside an element

terms.name: Padding
terms.tagline: 元素内容区域与边框之间的内侧留白间距。
terms.enTagline: Create space between a box and its content

terms.name: Border Radius
terms.tagline: 控制元素外框边角弧度与圆角曲率的外观样式属性。
terms.enTagline: Round the corners of a box

terms.name: Shadow
terms.tagline: 模拟光影投射效果以构建界面元素悬浮感与视觉层级深度的样式属性。
terms.enTagline: Use light and depth to separate overlapping surfaces

terms.name: Flex
terms.tagline: 沿一维主轴方向自动计算并分配子元素尺寸、对齐与间隙的弹性布局系统。
terms.enTagline: Arrange items along one row or one column

terms.name: Grid
terms.tagline: 基于二维行与列网格定位并分配元素位置与占比的二维排版系统。
terms.enTagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system

terms.name: Z-Index
terms.tagline: 定位元素在垂直屏幕轴向上的层叠与覆盖优先级规则。
terms.enTagline: Control which overlapping layer appears on top

terms.name: Opacity
terms.tagline: 透明度是通过 opacity 同时降低元素及其全部子内容可见程度的 CSS 属性
terms.enTagline: Make an element and its contents more transparent

terms.name: Hero
terms.tagline: 网页开头用来说明页面重点并引导下一步的主要区域
terms.enTagline: Use the opening area to explain the page's main point and next step

terms.name: CTA
terms.tagline: CTA 是引导用户执行注册、试用或购买等关键动作的核心入口。
terms.enTagline: Tell visitors the next action you want them to take

terms.name: Customer Testimonial
terms.tagline: 真实用户表达的使用体验、诉求与评价原话，用于校准产品需求与设计方向。
terms.enTagline: Use real customer words to show a concrete experience

terms.name: Header
terms.tagline: 网页顶部集中放置品牌、导航、搜索和账号入口的区域
terms.enTagline: The top section of a page that introduces the site or page and often contains navigation

terms.name: Navbar
terms.tagline: 顶部导航栏是网页页头中提供主要页面入口和当前位置提示的导航区域
terms.enTagline: Keep the brand, main destinations, and key action easy to reach

terms.name: Footer
terms.tagline: 页脚是网页底部集中放置补充链接、版权和联系方式的页面区域
terms.enTagline: End the page with useful links, identity, and required information

terms.name: FAQ
terms.tagline: 常见问题是集中回答用户反复提出的疑问及其答案的内容区块
terms.enTagline: Answer common questions before visitors need to ask

terms.name: Pricing
terms.tagline: 定价区是把多个套餐的价格、权益和适用对象并列比较的页面区块
terms.enTagline: Help visitors compare plans, cost, and included value

terms.name: Social Proof
terms.tagline: 通过展示他人使用证据与评价来降低信任成本、辅助用户决策的设计证明。
terms.enTagline: Support a product claim with evidence from real use

terms.name: Serif & Sans
terms.tagline: 衬线与非衬线是按笔画末端是否带有装饰来区分的两类字体风格
terms.enTagline: Choose letterforms that match the content and reading task

terms.name: Gradient
terms.tagline: 渐变是一种让两个或多个颜色在指定方向或范围内连续过渡的视觉效果
terms.enTagline: Blend colors gradually across an area

terms.name: Corner Feel
terms.tagline: 圆角的气质是指不同圆角大小在界面中带来的视觉感受和一致性规则
terms.enTagline: Use corner shape to support the product's visual tone

terms.name: Hover
terms.tagline: 指针设备悬停在交互元素上方时触发的即时视觉反馈状态。
terms.enTagline: Respond when a pointer rests over an interactive element

terms.name: Active
terms.tagline: 用户按下或触控元素期间触发的即时物理受力反馈状态。
terms.enTagline: Show that a control is being pressed right now

terms.name: Focus
terms.tagline: 控件当前接收键盘输入与用户操作焦点的激活状态。
terms.enTagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input

terms.name: Drag
terms.tagline: 拖拽是一种按住元素并移动它的位置或把它放到目标区域的交互方式
terms.enTagline: Move or reorder an item by holding and pulling it

terms.name: Disabled
terms.tagline: 禁用是表示控件当前不能执行操作的交互状态
terms.enTagline: Show that a control is currently unavailable

terms.name: Transition
terms.tagline: 控制 CSS 属性在不同状态转换过程中产生平滑渐变的动画机制。
terms.enTagline: Smooth the change between two visual states

terms.name: Animation
terms.tagline: 动画是一种用 @keyframes 定义多个阶段，并控制其播放方式的 CSS 动效
terms.enTagline: Run a planned sequence of visual changes

terms.name: Easing
terms.tagline: 缓动是规定动画在持续时间内如何加速和减速的速度曲线
terms.enTagline: Control how motion speeds up and slows down

terms.name: Spring
terms.tagline: 弹性动画是一种用刚度、阻尼和质量等物理参数计算运动的动效方式
terms.enTagline: Create motion that settles with weight and elasticity

terms.name: Fade In / Out
terms.tagline: 渐入渐出是一种通过改变透明度让内容出现或离开的基础动效
terms.enTagline: Reveal or hide an element by changing its opacity

terms.name: Text Truncate
terms.tagline: 文本截断是一种在有限空间内隐藏超出文字，并用省略号提示内容未显示完整的显示方式
terms.enTagline: Shorten text that cannot fit in the available space

terms.name: Backdrop Blur
terms.tagline: 毛玻璃是一种通过模糊元素背后画面，让半透明界面层与背景区分开的视觉效果
terms.enTagline: Blur the content behind a translucent surface

terms.name: Sticky
terms.tagline: 吸顶是一种让元素先按正常位置排列、滚动到指定边界后暂时固定显示的 CSS 定位方式
terms.enTagline: Keep an element visible after scrolling reaches it

terms.name: Cursor
terms.tagline: 鼠标指针会根据所在区域改变形状，提前提示这里可以点击、输入、拖动或暂不可用
terms.enTagline: The mouse pointer changes shape to preview whether an area can be clicked, typed in, dragged, or is currently unavailable

terms.name: Selection
terms.tagline: 选中高亮是用户拖选网页文字后，浏览器为选区显示的前景色和背景色
terms.enTagline: Show which text or items the user has selected

terms.name: Top Nav
terms.tagline: 顶部导航布局是一种把主要导航放在页面上方、下方安排内容区域的页面结构
terms.enTagline: Place the main navigation across the top of the page

terms.name: Sidebar
terms.tagline: 侧栏布局是一种把层级导航放在页面一侧、把主要任务内容放在另一侧的页面结构
terms.enTagline: Keep navigation in a vertical column beside the content

terms.name: Single Page
terms.tagline: 单页滚动布局是指将相关内容按阅读顺序组织在同一长页面中的布局方式。
terms.enTagline: Arrange a complete story in sections down one scrolling page

terms.name: Doc Layout
terms.tagline: 文档三栏布局是一种同时显示整站目录、正文内容和本页大纲的页面结构
terms.enTagline: Combine section navigation, article content, and an on-page outline

terms.name: Card Grid
terms.tagline: 卡片网格布局是一种用规则行列排列同类卡片，并随可用宽度换行的页面结构
terms.enTagline: Arrange similar cards in a responsive grid

terms.name: Centered Column
terms.tagline: 居中窄栏布局是一种限制内容栏宽度并将其置于页面中央的页面结构
terms.enTagline: Keep one narrow content column centered on the page

terms.name: Position
terms.tagline: 定位是通过 CSS position 和偏移量决定元素是否脱离文档流及其参照位置的布局规则
terms.enTagline: Place an element in normal flow, against a parent, or against the viewport

terms.name: Centering
terms.tagline: 居中是把文字、元素或一组内容在容器的水平、垂直或两条轴上对齐到中间的布局方式
terms.enTagline: Align an element to the middle of the available space

terms.name: Domain
terms.tagline: 域名是给网站、邮箱等网络服务使用的好记名称。
terms.enTagline: Give a website a human-readable address

terms.name: DNS
terms.tagline: 互联网的地址簿，把域名查成浏览器能找到网站的地址
terms.enTagline: Connect a domain name to the service that should answer

terms.name: URL
terms.tagline: URL 是浏览器用来打开某个页面、文件或位置的完整地址。
terms.enTagline: Describe the exact location of a resource on the web

terms.name: API
terms.tagline: 两个软件互相请求数据或功能时共同遵守的约定
terms.enTagline: An agreed way for two pieces of software to request and return information

terms.name: HTTP
terms.tagline: 浏览器或 App 向服务器提出请求、再接收结果时遵守的通信规则
terms.enTagline: Send a request and receive a response over the web

terms.name: JSON
terms.tagline: JSON 是软件之间传递成组信息时常用的一种文本写法。
terms.enTagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange

terms.name: HTTPS
terms.tagline: 地址栏里以 https:// 开头、用于保护设备与网站之间数据的加密连接
terms.enTagline: Encrypt the connection between the browser and the website

terms.name: CDN
terms.tagline: 把图片和网页文件的副本放到多个地区，让用户从较近的位置加载
terms.enTagline: Serve static files from locations closer to visitors

terms.name: Component
terms.tagline: 组件是把一块可复用的界面和它负责的行为组织在一起的单元。
terms.enTagline: A component is a unit that groups a reusable piece of interface with the behavior it owns.

terms.name: State
terms.tagline: 状态是界面在当前时刻需要记住、并会随操作或结果变化的信息。
terms.enTagline: State is information the interface needs to remember right now and that can change from actions or results.

terms.name: Port
terms.tagline: 端口是同一台主机上区分不同网络服务的编号入口。
terms.enTagline: A port is a numbered network entry that distinguishes services on the same host.

terms.name: Box Model
terms.tagline: 由内容、内边距、边框和外边距构成的网页元素几何尺寸与排版占位规则。
terms.enTagline: The box model is the browser's rule for the space used by an element's content, padding, border, and margin.

terms.name: Overflow
terms.tagline: 内容尺寸超出容器可见区域时的显示、裁剪或滚动控制规则。
terms.enTagline: Overflow is the rule for how the browser shows, clips, or scrolls content that exceeds a container's available space.

terms.name: CORS
terms.tagline: CORS 是浏览器要求服务器明确同意后，网页才能跨源读取响应的安全机制。
terms.enTagline: CORS is the browser security mechanism that lets a page read a cross-origin response only after the server explicitly permits it.

terms.name: Browser Storage
terms.tagline: 浏览器存储是网页把数据保存在用户当前浏览器中的本地机制。
terms.enTagline: Browser storage is a local web mechanism for keeping data in a person's current browser.

terms.name: SEO
terms.tagline: SEO 是帮助搜索引擎理解、发现和呈现网页内容的一组持续优化工作。
terms.enTagline: SEO is ongoing work that helps search engines understand, discover, and present web content.

terms.name: Redirect
terms.tagline: 重定向是服务器或浏览器把一个 URL 的访问带到另一个 URL 的机制。
terms.enTagline: A redirect is a mechanism that sends a visit from one URL to another URL.

terms.name: AI Hallucination
terms.tagline: AI 幻觉是模型生成看似可信、但不准确、无依据或虚构的信息。
terms.enTagline: An AI hallucination is information a model generates that looks credible but is inaccurate, unsupported, or invented.

terms.name: Chat UI
terms.tagline: 聊天界面是组织消息列表、输入区和对话反馈状态的交互界面。
terms.enTagline: A chat UI is the interactive interface that organizes a message list, input area, and conversation feedback states.

terms.name: Responsive Design
terms.tagline: 响应式设计是让同一界面根据可用空间和设备能力调整布局与交互的设计方法。
terms.enTagline: Responsive design is the practice of adapting one interface's layout and interaction to available space and device capabilities.

terms.name: Search
terms.tagline: 搜索是根据用户输入的关键词，从内容集合中找出可能相关结果的功能。
terms.enTagline: Search is a feature that uses a person's keywords to find potentially relevant results in a collection.

terms.name: Filter
terms.tagline: 筛选是按已有属性或条件缩小当前内容集合的功能。
terms.enTagline: Filtering is a feature that narrows the current content collection using existing properties or conditions.

terms.name: Chart
terms.tagline: 图表是用位置、长度、大小或颜色等视觉编码来比较和理解数据的展示方式。
terms.enTagline: A chart is a way to compare and understand data through visual encodings such as position, length, size, or color.

terms.name: Dark Mode
terms.tagline: 深色模式是一套可切换的深色界面主题状态，而不只是把页面背景涂黑。
terms.enTagline: Dark mode is a switchable dark interface theme state, not merely a page with a black background.

terms.name: Design Token
terms.tagline: 设计令牌是集中命名和复用颜色、间距、字体等设计值的变量。
terms.enTagline: A design token is a named variable that centrally stores and reuses design values such as color, spacing, and typography.

terms.name: Markdown
terms.tagline: Markdown 是用少量排版符号表示标题、列表和代码的结构化纯文本格式
terms.enTagline: Write structured text with lightweight punctuation

terms.name: HTML
terms.tagline: HTML 是用标签描述网页内容结构、供浏览器渲染页面的标记语言
terms.enTagline: Describe the structure and meaning of a web page

terms.name: Git
terms.tagline: Git 是在本地记录文件版本历史、比较改动并协作同步的版本控制工具
terms.enTagline: Keep a history of code changes so work can be compared and restored

terms.name: Terminal
terms.tagline: 终端命令行是通过输入文字命令操作电脑和运行程序的界面
terms.enTagline: Run text commands in a specific folder on your computer or server

terms.name: npm
terms.tagline: npm 是给 JavaScript 项目下载所需工具、运行项目命令的工具。
terms.enTagline: Install JavaScript packages and run project scripts

terms.name: Env Var
terms.tagline: 环境变量是在代码外保存设置值、让不同运行地点读取各自配置的方式。
terms.enTagline: Provide configuration outside the source code

terms.name: Deployment
terms.tagline: 把项目发布到目标环境运行，使目标用户或其他系统可以正常访问
terms.enTagline: Build the project and make it available on a server

terms.name: Database
terms.tagline: 保存并查找用户、文章、订单等应用数据的地方
terms.enTagline: Store and find application data such as users, posts, and orders

terms.name: Acceptance Criteria
terms.tagline: 验收标准是用来判断成果是否满足要求的一组明确可检查的结果条件。
terms.enTagline: Acceptance criteria are checkable conditions that determine whether a result is acceptable.

terms.name: Test Case
terms.tagline: 测试用例是写明前置条件、操作步骤、输入和预期结果的一次可重复检查。
terms.enTagline: A test case is one repeatable check that states preparation, action, input, and expected result.

terms.name: Unit Test
terms.tagline: 针对独立函数或单个组件执行功能逻辑隔离验证的单元测试。
terms.enTagline: A unit test tests one independently verifiable function, component, or small module.

terms.name: Integration Test
terms.tagline: 集成测试是验证多个模块、服务或依赖之间能否按约定正确协作的测试。
terms.enTagline: An integration test verifies that multiple modules or dependencies cooperate correctly.

terms.name: End-to-End Test
terms.tagline: 模拟真实用户跨页面跨系统完整操作流的端到端集成测试。
terms.enTagline: An end-to-end test follows a complete system flow from a user's entry point to the final result.

terms.name: Smoke Test
terms.tagline: 验证软件核心关键路径是否基本可用的极简冒烟测试。
terms.enTagline: A smoke test uses a few critical checks after a new build to decide whether the system is worth deeper testing.

terms.name: Regression Test
terms.tagline: 回归测试是确认一次修改没有破坏原本正常功能的测试。
terms.enTagline: Regression testing checks that a change has not broken functionality that previously worked.

terms.name: Build
terms.tagline: 构建是把项目文件整理成浏览器或服务器能够运行的成品的过程。
terms.enTagline: A build converts source code, dependencies, and configuration into a runnable or releasable artifact.

terms.name: CI
terms.tagline: 持续集成是在每次准备合并改动时，自动检查这些改动能否和现有项目一起正常工作的做法。
terms.enTagline: CI is the practice of automatically building and testing changes as they enter shared code, so integration problems appear early.

terms.cn: 持续交付 / 持续部署
terms.name: CD
terms.tagline: 持续交付和持续部署，是把检查通过的版本继续送往可访问地址的两种做法。
terms.enTagline: CD keeps verified versions continuously releasable, or releases them to production automatically under defined rules.

terms.name: Staging
terms.tagline: 预发布环境是在生产发布前，用接近生产的配置验证候选版本的独立环境。
terms.enTagline: Staging is an isolated pre-production environment used to validate a candidate release under production-like conditions.

terms.name: Test Coverage
terms.tagline: 测试覆盖率是衡量需求、代码结构或风险项有多少被测试触达的指标。
terms.enTagline: Test coverage measures how much of requirements, code structure, or risk paths have been reached by tests.

terms.name: Test Double
terms.tagline: 测试替身是在检查时，用可控制的假对象代替真实外部服务的做法。
terms.enTagline: A test double is a controllable object that replaces a real dependency during testing.

terms.name: Test Data and Fixture
terms.tagline: 测试数据是检查时使用的固定内容；Fixture 是每次准备和清理这些内容的步骤。
terms.enTagline: Test data are input and state samples; a fixture is a reusable setup and cleanup mechanism.

terms.name: Flaky Test
terms.tagline: 不稳定测试是在代码未改变时仍会时而通过、时而失败的测试。
terms.enTagline: A flaky test sometimes passes and sometimes fails when the code has not changed.

terms.name: Lint
terms.tagline: Lint 是不启动整个项目、只检查代码写法是否有常见问题的工具。
terms.enTagline: Lint is static checking that uses source rules to find suspicious patterns and consistency problems without running the full program.

terms.name: Monitoring
terms.tagline: 监控是持续采集和观察生产指标、日志与告警，以发现异常并判断系统健康。
terms.enTagline: Monitoring continuously observes production metrics, logs, and alerts to find anomalies and judge system health.

terms.name: Rollback
terms.tagline: 回滚是把系统或配置恢复到先前已知可用状态，以停止新版本造成的影响。
terms.enTagline: Rollback restores a system or configuration to a previous known-good state to stop current impact.

terms.name: Feature Flag
terms.tagline: 功能开关是运行时按配置或用户条件启用、停用代码路径的机制。
terms.enTagline: A feature flag enables or disables a code path at runtime according to configuration or user conditions.

terms.name: Commit
terms.tagline: 给当前项目保存一个可以回看、带说明的版本
terms.enTagline: Save one meaningful set of changes in the project history

terms.name: Branch
terms.tagline: 从当前版本另开一条修改路线，让新功能先不混进主版本
terms.enTagline: Develop an independent line of work without changing the main line

terms.name: Merge
terms.tagline: 合并是把另一条修改路线上的已保存改动放进当前路线的操作。
terms.enTagline: Combine the commits from one branch into another

terms.name: Pull
terms.tagline: 拉取是把网上已经保存的新版本同步到当前项目的操作。
terms.enTagline: Download remote changes and integrate them into the current branch

terms.name: Push
terms.tagline: 推送是把电脑上已保存的版本上传到共享代码网站的操作。
terms.enTagline: Upload local commits to a remote repository

terms.name: Clone
terms.tagline: 克隆是第一次把共享代码网站上的项目和版本记录完整下载到电脑的操作。
terms.enTagline: Create a local copy of a remote repository and its history

terms.name: Pull Request
terms.tagline: 合并请求是在 GitHub 或 GitLab 上查看改动、讨论并决定是否合并的页面。
terms.enTagline: Ask others to review and merge the work from one branch

terms.name: Worktree
terms.tagline: 让同一个 Git 仓库同时出现在多个文件夹里，每个文件夹处理一条分支
terms.enTagline: Check out another branch in a second working directory

terms.name: Stash
terms.tagline: 把当前没做完的改动临时收起来，让工作区先恢复干净
terms.enTagline: Temporarily set aside uncommitted changes

terms.name: .gitignore
terms.tagline: 告诉 Git 哪些本地文件不要加入版本记录的规则清单
terms.enTagline: Tell Git which untracked files should stay out of version control

terms.name: Diff
terms.tagline: 把改动前后的内容逐行摆在一起，标出删了什么、加了什么
terms.enTagline: See exactly what changed between two states

terms.name: Frontend
terms.tagline: 用户在网页、小程序和软件里直接看到、点击和输入的那一层
terms.enTagline: The layer people directly see, click, and type into

terms.name: Backend
terms.tagline: 用户通常看不见、负责处理请求和数据的服务器端部分
terms.enTagline: The server-side part people usually cannot see that handles requests and data

terms.name: Backend Framework
terms.tagline: 开发后端时使用的现成项目骨架，帮助组织请求、处理代码和错误
terms.enTagline: Use a shared structure for routes, requests, data, and server behavior

terms.name: Route & Endpoint
terms.tagline: 路由决定访问一个网址或执行一种操作时，应交给后端的哪段功能处理。
terms.enTagline: Match a request path and method to the code that handles it

terms.name: SQL
terms.tagline: 后端或数据库工具用来查找和修改关系型数据的语言
terms.enTagline: Ask a relational database to read or change structured records

terms.name: Validation
terms.tagline: 数据校验是在使用输入前检查其格式、范围和业务规则的步骤
terms.enTagline: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values

terms.name: Authentication
terms.tagline: 确认当前用户身份的检查过程
terms.enTagline: Verify who is making the request

terms.name: Authorization
terms.tagline: 确认身份后，根据规则判断用户是否有权访问特定界面或执行某项操作
terms.enTagline: Decide what an authenticated user is allowed to see or change

terms.name: Serverless
terms.tagline: Serverless 是让云平台按需要运行后端代码、免去自己维护服务器的一种方式。
terms.enTagline: Run backend code on demand without managing a long-running server

terms.name: Server Logs
terms.tagline: 记录后端运行时发生了什么，主要用来查找失败原因
terms.enTagline: Record what the server did so problems can be traced

terms.name: User Story
terms.tagline: 以“角色 + 诉求 + 价值”为结构，从真实用户视角描述功能预期的需求表达框架。
terms.enTagline: A brief requirement that states who needs what and why from the user's perspective

terms.name: Use Case
terms.tagline: 描述参与者为达成目标与系统交互时的正常路径和重要例外
terms.enTagline: A description of the main interaction and important exceptions between an actor and a system while reaching a goal

terms.name: User Flow
terms.tagline: 画出用户从入口到完成目标所经过步骤和分支的路径图
terms.enTagline: A path diagram of the steps and branches a user takes to reach one goal

terms.name: User Journey
terms.tagline: 按阶段记录用户跨触点完成目标时的行动、想法、感受和阻碍
terms.enTagline: A staged view of a user's actions, thoughts, feelings, and obstacles across touchpoints while pursuing a goal

terms.name: PRD
terms.tagline: 系统阐述产品背景、用户价值、功能范围与验收标准的结构化需求文档。
terms.enTagline: A product document that defines the user problem, scope, and success criteria

terms.name: MVP
terms.tagline: 以最低成本构建核心可用闭环、用于验证核心业务假设的产品最小原型版本。
terms.enTagline: The smallest real product or experiment that tests a key product assumption

terms.name: Product Backlog
terms.tagline: 按顺序维护产品未来可能需要完成的功能、修复和改进的动态清单
terms.enTagline: A dynamic, ordered list of features, fixes, and improvements that a product may need next

terms.name: Product Roadmap
terms.tagline: 按时间范围表达产品目标、重点方向和预期成果的动态计划
terms.enTagline: A dynamic plan that communicates product goals, priorities, and expected outcomes across time horizons

terms.name: Gantt Chart
terms.tagline: 用时间轴横条展示任务起止时间、持续周期、里程碑和依赖关系的排期图
terms.enTagline: A schedule chart that uses timeline bars to show task dates, duration, milestones, and dependencies

terms.name: A/B Test
terms.tagline: 把符合条件的用户随机分到不同版本，并用预先确定的指标比较结果的实验方法
terms.enTagline: An experiment that randomly assigns eligible users to variants and compares them using predefined metrics

terms.name: Conversion Funnel
terms.tagline: 按既定步骤统计用户数量和转化比例，用来发现从入口到目标结果之间的流失位置
terms.enTagline: A sequence of user counts and conversion rates that locates drop-off from entry to a target outcome

terms.name: Tech Stack
terms.tagline: 技术栈是一套项目实际使用的编程语言、现成框架、数据服务和运行工具。
terms.enTagline: The set of languages, frameworks, data services, and tools used to build and run software

terms.name: JavaScript
terms.tagline: JavaScript 是让网页响应点击、输入等操作，也能处理程序逻辑的编程语言。
terms.enTagline: A programming language that makes a web page respond to actions and data

terms.name: TypeScript
terms.tagline: TypeScript 是在 JavaScript 上增加“数据应是什么样”检查的编程语言。
terms.enTagline: A language that checks written code for mismatched names and value types before it runs

terms.name: Python
terms.tagline: Python 是常用于自动化、数据处理和服务器程序的通用编程语言
terms.enTagline: A programming language often used to automate work on a computer or server

terms.name: React
terms.tagline: React 是把网页拆成可复用部分，并让画面跟随数据变化的工具。
terms.enTagline: A JavaScript library for building interactive interfaces from components and state

terms.name: Vue
terms.tagline: Vue 是把网页拆成可复用部分，并让画面跟随数据变化的工具。
terms.enTagline: A JavaScript framework for building interactive interfaces with templates and components

terms.name: Next.js
terms.tagline: Next.js 是基于 React 搭建完整网站的工具，常用于官网、内容站和带登录的网站。
terms.enTagline: A React framework for building full websites and web applications

terms.name: Tailwind CSS
terms.tagline: Tailwind CSS 是用一组现成短代码直接写网页外观的工具。
terms.enTagline: A utility-first CSS framework that styles elements through small class names

terms.name: shadcn/ui
terms.tagline: shadcn/ui 是一套可复制到项目里、由项目自己维护的按钮、表单和弹窗代码。
terms.enTagline: A collection of editable UI component code that you add to a React project

terms.name: Vibe Coding
terms.tagline: Vibe Coding 是指用自然语言向 AI 表达需求，由 AI 编写代码，再根据运行结果持续迭代调整的开发方式。
terms.enTagline: Building software by describing the desired result to an AI agent and reviewing the work it makes

terms.name: AI Agent
terms.tagline: 具备目标感知、自主规划、工具调用与多步执行能力的 AI 系统。
terms.enTagline: An AI system that can plan steps, use permitted tools, and act on results toward a goal

terms.name: Context Engineering
terms.tagline: 系统化筛选、编排并向大模型提供最高相关度上下文信息的工程方法。
terms.enTagline: Organizing the goals, rules, source material, and latest results an AI receives for each turn

terms.name: Harness Engineering
terms.tagline: Agent 运行框架工程是把项目知识、工具、状态、权限和检查做成 AI Agent 可用工作环境的工程实践。
terms.enTagline: The engineering practice of turning project knowledge, tools, state, permissions, and checks into a working environment an AI agent can use

terms.name: Human-in-the-loop
terms.tagline: 人在回路是在 AI 工作流的关键判断或高风险动作前暂停，让人审阅、批准、拒绝或修正后再继续的机制。
terms.enTagline: Pausing an AI workflow before a critical decision or high-risk action so a person can review, approve, reject, or correct it

terms.name: Sub-agent
terms.tagline: 由主 Agent 调度、专注处理特定独立子任务的专项执行单元。
terms.enTagline: A separate agent the main agent assigns to a bounded part of a larger task

terms.name: AI Application Basics
terms.tagline: AI 应用是把 AI 放进网页或软件里，让用户提问或完成任务的产品。
terms.enTagline: A product that uses an AI model, an interface, and sometimes tools to help people complete tasks

terms.name: Multimodal AI
terms.tagline: 多模态 AI 能在同一个任务里结合文字、图片、音频或视频等不同形式的信息。
terms.enTagline: AI that can combine information such as text, images, audio, or video in one task

terms.name: Token
terms.tagline: Token 是 AI 读取和生成文字、标点或代码时使用的计数单位。
terms.enTagline: A small piece of text or code that a model reads and writes

terms.name: Context Window
terms.tagline: 上下文窗口是 AI 一次回答时能够同时参考的资料和回答内容的总量上限。
terms.enTagline: The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request

terms.name: System Prompt
terms.tagline: 系统提示词是 AI 产品在背后先交给模型的规则，例如客服助手该用什么语气、哪些问题不能自行处理。
terms.enTagline: Instructions an AI product gives the model behind the scenes to guide its behavior

terms.name: Conversation History
terms.tagline: 对话历史是产品保存的旧消息，其中与当前问题有关的部分可以在下一次请求中再次交给模型。
terms.enTagline: Conversation history is the earlier messages a product saves and can include again when they matter to a new request

terms.name: Stateless Request
terms.tagline: 无状态请求是一次模型调用只依据本次收到的内容，不会自动保留上一轮输入和结果。
terms.enTagline: A stateless request is a model call that uses only what it receives this time and does not automatically retain prior input or results

terms.name: Structured Output
terms.tagline: 结构化输出是要求 AI 按事先约定的栏目和格式返回结果的方式。
terms.enTagline: Model output returned in an agreed, machine-checkable shape

terms.name: Streaming Response
terms.tagline: 流式响应是 AI 一边生成内容，界面一边逐段显示内容的方式。
terms.enTagline: A response sent and displayed in consecutive pieces as it is generated

terms.name: Tool Calling
terms.tagline: 工具调用是 AI 请求应用执行某项操作，再读取操作结果的方式。
terms.enTagline: A model’s request for an application to run a named tool with parameters

terms.name: ReAct
terms.tagline: ReAct 是让 AI 根据当前证据选择一个操作，读取真实结果，再据此选择下一步的任务方式。
terms.enTagline: A task pattern where an agent decides, acts with a tool, observes the result, and decides again

terms.name: Agent Loop
terms.tagline: Agent 循环是应用反复调用 AI 和工具，并根据检查结果决定继续、暂停或结束的运行机制。
terms.enTagline: A runtime mechanism that repeatedly calls AI and tools, then uses check results to continue, pause, or stop

terms.name: TTFT / TPS
terms.tagline: TTFT 和 TPS 分别表示 AI 出现第一段回答前的等待时间，以及之后每秒生成多少内容。
terms.enTagline: Measures of time to first output and of token generation speed after output begins

terms.name: Token Usage & Cost
terms.tagline: AI 处理的文字片段会逐轮累加，费用还要按所用模型的价格计算。
terms.enTagline: The cumulative model tokens in a task and the price calculated from the model’s rate card

terms.name: Rate Limit
terms.tagline: 速率限制是服务规定一段时间内最多能发多少次请求、处理多少内容或同时运行多少任务的上限。
terms.enTagline: A service limit on requests, tokens, or concurrent tasks within a period of time

terms.name: Minimalism
terms.tagline: 现代简约是一种减少非必要装饰、突出内容和操作的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Remove what does not help the task and make the remaining hierarchy clear

terms.name: Apple HIG
terms.tagline: 苹果风是一种借鉴 Apple 产品界面和官网表达方式的设计风格
terms.enTagline: Use precise hierarchy, generous space, and polished product imagery

terms.name: Notion Style
terms.tagline: Notion 风是一种以文档阅读和编辑为中心的轻量界面风格
terms.enTagline: Use document-like structure, quiet surfaces, and practical controls

terms.name: Bento Grid
terms.tagline: Bento 便当格是一种用大小不同的卡片组织并列信息的网格布局
terms.enTagline: Arrange different kinds of content in a clear modular grid

terms.name: Glassmorphism
terms.tagline: 玻璃拟态是一种用半透明和背景模糊表现前后层次的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Use translucent, blurred surfaces to separate layered content

terms.name: Neo-Brutalism
terms.tagline: 新粗野是一种用粗描边、硬阴影和高对比色建立强烈识别的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Use direct structure, strong contrast, and deliberately exposed construction

terms.name: Swiss Style
terms.tagline: 瑞士排版是一种用严格网格、无衬线字体和清楚对齐组织信息的设计风格
terms.enTagline: Build clarity through grid, typography, and objective visual order

terms.name: Editorial
terms.tagline: 杂志编辑风是一种借用纸媒排版方法组织网页内容的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Use publication-style typography, imagery, and pacing to tell a story

terms.name: Skeuomorphism
terms.tagline: 拟物化是一种模仿现实物体外观和操作线索的界面设计风格
terms.enTagline: Use familiar real-world form and material to explain a digital control

terms.name: Flat Design
terms.tagline: 扁平化是一种减少立体材质、用纯色和简化图形组织界面的设计风格
terms.enTagline: Use simple shapes, clear color, and minimal surface decoration

terms.name: Material Design
terms.tagline: Material Design 是 Google 推出的一套跨设备界面设计系统
terms.enTagline: Use a systematic component language with clear layers and motion

terms.name: Neumorphism
terms.tagline: 新拟态是一种用同色背景和明暗双阴影表现凸凹质感的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Use paired soft shadows to make controls appear pressed from one surface

terms.name: SaaS Marketing Site
terms.tagline: SaaS 产品官网是一种面向软件订阅产品的营销网站类型
terms.enTagline: Place the value, product proof, and next action on one clear reading path

terms.name: B2B Corporate Site
terms.tagline: B2B 企业官网是一种面向组织采购决策的网站类型
terms.enTagline: Build confidence through stable structure, concrete evidence, and real business context

terms.name: DTC E-commerce
terms.tagline: DTC 品牌电商是一种由品牌直接面向消费者销售商品的网站类型
terms.enTagline: Let product, brand feeling, and buying information work together toward a decision

terms.name: Dark UI
terms.tagline: 深色界面是一种以深色背景和浅色前景为主的界面配色方案
terms.enTagline: Build clear hierarchy with a dark color scheme instead of simply turning the page black

terms.name: Playful Illustration
terms.tagline: 趣味插画是一种用角色、场景和夸张图形建立品牌个性的视觉方向
terms.enTagline: Use distinctive character, shape, and feedback to make a product feel friendly and alive

terms.name: Organic Design
terms.tagline: 有机设计是一种借用自然形状、材料纹理和大地色的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Create warmth through natural material, real people, and a gentler pace

terms.name: Y2K
terms.tagline: Y2K 是一种重新演绎千禧年前后数字文化的复古视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Use glossy digital optimism, bright plastic color, and early-2000s references

terms.name: Memphis
terms.tagline: 孟菲斯是一种用鲜明配色、几何图案和不对称构图表达活力的设计风格
terms.enTagline: Use bold geometry, pattern, and asymmetry for an energetic composition

terms.name: Terminal Aesthetic
terms.tagline: 终端极客风是一种借用命令行界面元素的网页视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Borrow command-line language to feel direct, technical, and tool-like

terms.name: Wabi-sabi
terms.tagline: 侘寂风是一种用自然材料、留白和不对称表达时间与不完美的视觉风格
terms.enTagline: Use natural material, space, and asymmetry to create a quiet pace

terms.name: Model Context Protocol
terms.tagline: 规范 AI 模型与外部数据源及工具双向调用的标准化开放协议。
terms.enTagline: A connection protocol AI applications use to discover and call external tools, data, and prompts

terms.name: Skill
terms.tagline: 按约定目录结构组织的专业工作流与指令集包，以 SKILL.md 为统一入口供智能体按需调取执行。
terms.enTagline: A specialized workflow and instruction package organized in a standard directory, with SKILL.md as the entry point for agents to execute on demand.
